verdict.rationale: Apple provides multiple official SDKs/frameworks for AI development on M4 Pro hardware — Metal (GPU compute, ML integration), Core ML, MLX (open-source Apple Silicon ML framework), and PyTorch backend support — giving AI-native developers first-party tooling to build against. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration of building real AI apps with these SDKs, and no unified 'AI SDK' overview beyond scattered docs pages.
